findings.summary: Tracked state treated the historical main baseline as a permanent live-main invariant.
UI was listed as allowed while the closure review was open and UI remained forbidden.
PR-only review/evidence was incorrectly declared as merged-main CI.

correction_scope.baseline_semantics: baseline_main_sha is historical closure context; GitHub LIVE resolves current main
correction_scope.next_action_semantics: closure review is the sole tracked action until live PR #12 approval and merge
correction_scope.main_ci_semantics: post_merge_main_ci contains exactly the two observed merged-main CI contexts
